T: One last adventure. One more helping.
D: In 1969 Indy and his goddaughter race a former Nazi to find an ancient device that can change history.
P: Serve the snacks when the tuk-tuk chase tears through Tangier.
S: the tuk-tuk chase through the streets of Tangier
Lamb kofta of mince, onion, cumin and parsley shaped on skewers and grilled, with a harissa yoghurt dip.
diving for the dial in the Aegean Sea with Renaldo
Baby octopus marinated in olive oil, lemon and oregano, grilled hot and fast, served with lemon and capers.
the 1969 ticker tape parade in New York

New York street-cart soft pretzels dipped in bicarb water, sprinkled with rock salt and baked deep brown, served warm with spicy brown mustard. Mix 400g plain flour, 7g dried yeast, 1 tsp sugar, 1 tsp salt and 250ml warm water, knead 8 minutes and prove 1 hour. Shape 8 big pretzels and dip each in 2L boiling water with 60g bicarb soda for 30 seconds. Sprinkle with rock salt and bake at 220C for 12 minutes. Mix 3 tbsp wholegrain mustard with 1 tsp hot English mustard and 1 tsp honey to serve.
M: the journey to Syracuse in Sicily

Swordfish steaks seared golden, finished with a sweet and sour caponata of eggplant, tomato, olives, capers and pine nuts, with crusty bread. Cube an eggplant and fry in olive oil until golden. Add a sliced onion and 2 celery sticks and soften. Stir in 400g crushed tomatoes, 2 tbsp red wine vinegar, 1 tbsp sugar, 50g green olives and 1 tbsp capers and simmer 15 minutes. Toast 30g pine nuts and stir through with basil. Season 4 swordfish steaks and sear 2 minutes a side. Serve on the caponata with crusty bread.
the Moroccan leg of the hunt
Chicken thighs slow cooked with preserved lemon, green olives, ginger, saffron and onion, served over couscous.
W: Icy Sicilian almond milk granita scraped into glasses, served the local way with a warm split brioche bun for dunking. Blend 200g ground almonds with 800ml water and 150g caster sugar, stand 30 minutes and strain well through a cloth, squeezing hard. Stir in 1 tsp almond extract. Pour into a shallow tray and freeze, scraping with a fork every 40 minutes for 3 hours until fluffy ice crystals form. Warm 4 brioche buns at 160C for 5 minutes. Spoon the granita into glasses and serve with the brioche.
K: Green tea brewed with plenty of fresh mint and sugar, poured from a height into small glasses.

s.note: the tuk-tuk chase through the streets of Tangier
s.how: Mix 500g lamb mince with a grated onion, a teaspoon of cumin, chopped parsley and salt. Shape around skewers and grill over high heat until charred and cooked through. Stir a spoon of harissa through Greek yoghurt and serve as a dip.

s.note: diving for the dial in the Aegean Sea with Renaldo
s.how: Marinate 600g baby octopus in olive oil, lemon juice and oregano for an hour. Grill on a very hot plate for 2 to 3 minutes until charred and just tender. Pile onto a plate, scatter with capers and serve with lemon wedges.

m.note: the Moroccan leg of the hunt
m.how: Brown 1kg chicken thighs, then soften a sliced onion with grated ginger and a pinch of saffron. Add 500ml water, chopped preserved lemon and a handful of green olives. Cover and simmer for 45 minutes until tender. Serve over fluffy couscous.

w.how: Blend 200g ground almonds with 800ml water and 150g caster sugar, stand 30 minutes and strain well through a cloth, squeezing hard. Stir in 1 tsp almond extract. Pour into a shallow tray and freeze, scraping with a fork every 40 minutes for 3 hours until fluffy ice crystals form. Warm 4 brioche buns at 160C for 5 minutes. Spoon the granita into glasses and serve with the brioche.

d.how: Put 2 tbsp green tea leaves and a big bunch of fresh mint into a teapot with sugar to taste. Pour over a litre of just-boiled water and steep for 4 minutes. Pour from a height into small glasses so it froths, then pour back and pour again.
